Results.ReviewText:
I had previously bought a small Spirit E-210 for use at our family cottage.  This E-310 is a replacement for a ten year old grill at our home.  

I am delighted with the performance of the grill proper, but it has some of the same problems I have had with previous grills by other manufacturers.  Specifically, since the grill is used outdoors, the local birds love to find any way into it to make a nest.  On previous grills, and now with this one, I have had to make minor modifications to 'bird-proof' the grill.  I have added a hardware cloth closure for the rear and added a sheet metal tray to the bottom (to close the hole the LP tank would have hung from the gauge device).  Thank you for making the cover's rear vent and the Rotisserie shaft holes too small for bird entry.
Results.Title: Great grill - not bird proof

Results.ReviewText: We purchased the Weber  Spirit E-310  barbeque a few months ago . We decided it was time to purchase a new grill as ours was very old, still usable but we wanted something smaller. I have heard good reviews regarding Weber and happened to find one on sale . We did not want one with the side burner and this was a plus for us. I would however have liked for it to have the drop down side shelves. The unit was already assembled so cant comment on putting it together. That was also a plus!  No arguing or frustration.  This unit was purchased in Alberta,Canada so i dont know if propane tanks are different in the States but  we cannot use the propane tank gauge as the tank (20 lbs.)  doesnt fit /cant be hung . Because of this, the tank would have had to sit on the ground and make moving the grill very difficult. We placed a piece of small plywood across the bottom hole  and  put the tank on this &  rectified the problem.   Disappointed by this but even now would not be a factor in buying. Love the ease of cleaning the grease trap and general cleanup. So far, we are happy with this model and  hope it will last us for a long time.  We keep it on a covered deck and a  cover on when not in use.
Results.Title: Weber-Spirit E-310 Grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
